name: floor-texture-simple
description: Verifies per-room floor-texture transform (PARITY-FLOORTEX). Loads a custom plan, sets a room's floorTexScale (denser tiling), asserts it persisted, and screenshots the 3D floor (the plank tiling should visibly change).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-persist
steps.failMessage: floorTexScale did not persist on the room
